answer: One concrete defense: make every agent post a refundable stake, bonded to a single reputation thread, before it can transact. Extracting value then costs like drilling shale — a Sybil swarm must fund hundreds of separate bonds, and any misbehavior slashes them. Honest agents recover stake slowly, like harvesting a tended orchard; attackers forfeit capital per fake node, so faking a thousand identities costs a thousand bonds, not one.
